products.body_html:
Introducing the Bacca Bucci Gourmet Collection, where streetwear meets dessert-inspired indulgence. This high-top sneaker series is crafted for sneakerheads who crave both style and substance. With a blend of premium materials and a flavor-packed aesthetic, each drop represents a different taste sensation—just like your favorite desserts. We’re launching with three delicious colorways, with four more to drop every month, keeping your sneaker game fresh and flavorful.

 

  • Dessert-Inspired Aesthetics: The Gourmet Collection takes inspiration from artisanal desserts, bringing a mix of rich tones and textures to create sneakers that look as good as they feel. Each colorway embodies a unique dessert-inspired theme, making your footwear a sweet statement.

  • Superior Comfort with Rebound Technology: Featuring high-grade PU insocks with superior rebound, these sneakers are designed to keep your feet cushioned and energized, whether you're strolling through the city or hitting the streets in style.

  • Durable & High-Performance Build: Crafted with a PU upper, these sneakers provide a perfect blend of flexibility and durability. The breathable material ensures all-day comfort, while the high-grade rubber outsole offers exceptional grip and longevity.

  • Limited Edition Monthly Drops: Just like seasonal dessert specials, we’re releasing four additional flavors (colorways) every month, keeping the collection fresh and exclusive. Be ready to grab your favorite flavor before it’s gone!
  • Street Ready with a Premium Edge: Designed for urban explorers, sneaker enthusiasts, and trendsetters, these high-tops bring a luxury streetwear appeal while staying true to Bacca Bucci’s craftsmanship and comfort ethos.

products.title: FRONTIER
products.body_html:
Women-Specific Trekking Fit: Engineered exclusively for women, Frontier features a refined ankle height, supportive collar padding, and a snug heel lock that adapts to the female foot structure—ensuring better balance, reduced fatigue, and confident movement on uneven terrain.

High-Grade Textile & Fabric Upper: Crafted using premium high-performance textile and fabric panels, the upper delivers exceptional durability while staying lightweight and breathable. It flexes naturally with foot movement, resists abrasion on rocky trails, and dries faster during stream crossings.

Ultra-Grip Trail Outsole: Equipped with a rugged, multi-directional lug outsole designed for hiking and trekking, Frontier offers superior traction on rocks, mud, forest paths, and wet surfaces—giving you surefooted control during climbs, descents, and unpredictable terrain.

All-Day Comfort & Shock Absorption: The cushioned midsole absorbs impact with every step, reducing stress on knees and joints during long treks. A padded tongue and ankle support keep the foot secure and comfortable, even on extended outdoor adventures.

Trail-Ready Protection & Stability: A reinforced toe guard protects against rocks and roots, while the supportive ankle structure helps prevent twists and slips. Whether it’s high-altitude hikes, forest trails, or weekend getaways, Frontier is built to handle it all.

products.title: EXPEDITION
products.body_html:
• Mid-top build for confident ankle support: The boot’s mid-top silhouette with a padded collar wraps higher around the ankle for a more secure feel. It adds support and stability for longer walks and uneven surfaces—without feeling like a heavy, tall boot.
  •  Reinforced toe and wrap-around protection where it matters: A prominent textured toe bumper and rugged front overlay help protect the forefoot from scuffs and daily impact zones. It’s designed for men who are hard on their footwear—commutes, travel, and outdoorsy weekends included.
  • Secure lacing system that locks your fit: Rope-style laces run through a combination of webbing loops and metal hardware (D-ring and speed-hook style fittings). This setup helps you fine-tune tightness across the foot and keep the fit steady, especially during long wear.

  • Cushioned ride with a chunky, trail-inspired sole: A thick, sculpted midsole gives the boot a bold stance and a more cushioned underfoot feel. The outsole shows visible tread depth along the edges for a rugged grip-ready look that matches the boot’s expedition vibe.

  • Layered panel construction for a premium, rugged finish: The upper uses a multi-panel build—suede-like matte sections, smooth overlays, and mesh-textured areas on the tongue/collar—stitched together for a structured, durable aesthetic. Branding is kept clean and strong with a tongue patch and side branding, plus a practical heel pull tab for easy wear.

products.title: MELTS
products.body_html:

products.title: Founder Edition
products.body_html:
• Bold Low-Top Build: The Founder Edition comes in a clean low-top silhouette with a broad, grounded sole unit that gives the shoe a solid street-lifestyle stance. The shape looks structured, modern, and built for all-day everyday wear.

  • Panelled Textured Upper: The upper combines smooth and pebbled-finish panels with visible layered construction across the toe, quarter, and heel. Criss-cross overlay lines on the side and vamp add design character without making the shoe look busy.

  • Comfort-Focused Collar: The padded collar and tongue visibly add comfort around the ankle and instep, while the lace-up closure helps create a secure fit. The inner lining also appears soft and cushioned for daily movement.

  • Stable Sole Platform: The thick midsole has a wide, supportive profile with sculpted sidewall detailing that adds both presence and stability. Its flat, planted base makes the shoe look dependable for regular walking and daily use.
  • Grip-Ready Outsole: The outsole shows a patterned traction layout with circular grip zones and diamond-textured sections underneath. This gives the sneaker a more controlled, stable underfoot feel while reinforcing the durable everyday look.
